_readme: Per-creator monthly booking reconciliation, keyed by the creator's telemetry slug (cr-<handle>). Updated monthly from the GetYourGuide partner report: filter campaigns beginning 'cr-', and for each, fill {bookings, gross, commission, status, updated}. Commission = 4% of gross (5% once a creator passes 25 bookings in a quarter). The creator dashboard reads this file by slug. Example: "cr-chadkoga": {"bookings": 3, "gross": 1240, "commission": 49.60, "status": "accruing — pays out over $25", "updated": "2026-08-01"}
